# Third-party code

| File | What | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `stb_image.h` | v2.30 of Sean Barrett's image loader (PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF), from https://github.com/nothings/stb | public domain or MIT (your choice), see the end of the file |

Flaux uses it to load pictures for `image(...)` in graphics programs.
